post.description: Public. With `session` omitted or `"bearer"`, answers a bearer token for the `Authorization` header (tools, tests, pilot processes). With `"cookie"` (the browser application) the request must carry `X-ADLC-CSRF: sign-in`; the answer sets the HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie `adlc_session` and carries the session's CSRF value instead of the token. A wrong account or password answers `401` without saying which.
